acquisition method: Tandem mass spectra were acquired using an LTQ- Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer controlled by Xcalibur 2.1 software (Thermo Scientific) and operated in data-dependent acquisition mode.
cleavage agent: These samples were subject to SDS-PAGE electrophoresis and processed by in-gel trypsinization followed by LC-MS/MS analysis on a Orbitrap Velos instrument at the University of Bristol.
collision energy: Fragmentation conditions in the LTQ were as follows: normalized collision energy, 40%
enrichment method: At the same time, an m7GTP-Sepharose enrichment was performed to determine the effect of viral infection on the composition of eIF4E-containing cap-binding complexes
fractionation method: gel lane was cut into 10 slices
For the whole cell lysate experiments, the gel lane was cut into 10 slices and each slice subjected to in-gel tryptic digestion using a ProGest automated digestion unit (Digilab UK).
instrument: The resulting peptides were fractionated using an Ultimate 3000 nanoHPLC system in line with an LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
ionization type: Peptides were ionized by nanoelectrospray ionization at 2.1 kV using a stainless steel emitter with an internal diameter of 30 μm (Thermo Scientific) and a capillary temperature of 250 °C.
labeling: A SILAC-based mass spectrometry approach was employed to analyze changes to protein abundance in both whole cell and m7GTP-enriched samples
